subject: Science
overview: Indha lesson-la plants, animals, avanga body features, habitats, adaptations matrum biodiversity-ai observe panni compare pannuvom. Oru region-la irukkura living things ellam environment-oda connect aagirukkanga-nu purinjukkolvom.
learning_objectives: Biodiversity-na enna-nu own words-la explain panna mudiyum.
Plants-ai stem, root, leaf features base-la group panna mudiyum.
Taproot-um fibrous root-um, parallel-um reticulate venation-um compare panna mudiyum.
Animals-oda habitats matrum body features-ai compare panna mudiyum.
Adaptation living things-ku environment-la survive panna eppadi help pannudhu-nu solla mudiyum.
Local biodiversity-ai observe panni protect panna ways suggest panna mudiyum.

teaching_sequence.title: Namma sutri irukkura biodiversity
teaching_sequence.caption: Oru garden, park, illa school ground-la different plants, birds, insects-ai observe pannunga. Ella living things-um same-aa irukkaadhu; size, shape, colour, food, habitat ellam vary aagum. Oru area-la irukkura living things-oda variety-thaan biodiversity.
teaching_sequence.teacher_says: Oru marathula birds, insects, leaves, flowers ellam irukkalaam. Nature-la variety irukkuradhu dhaan biodiversity. Neenga paatha rendu different living things-ai compare pannunga.
teaching_sequence.checkpoint: Biodiversity-na enna? Ungal area-la paatha rendu different living things sollunga.

teaching_sequence.title: Plants-oda variety
teaching_sequence.caption: Plants-la trees, shrubs, herbs, climbers, creepers madhiri different growth forms irukku. Height, stem strength, branching pattern, growing place base-la avatrai observe panni group pannalaam.
teaching_sequence.teacher_says: Periya maram, small shrub, soft-stem herb ellam plant-thaan; aana growth pattern different. Stem eppadi irukku-nu paarthu classify pannuvom.
teaching_sequence.checkpoint: Tree, shrub, herb — ivatrukku oru oru example sollunga. Stem-la enna difference?

teaching_sequence.title: Root matrum stem structure
teaching_sequence.caption: Sila plants-ku main root-lirundhu side roots varum; adhu taproot. Sila plants-ku similar size roots bunch-aa varum; adhu fibrous root. Stem plant-ai support pannum; sila stems soft, sila woody.
teaching_sequence.teacher_says: Plant-ai careful-aa observe pannumbodhu root structure different-aa irukkum. Root plant-ai soil-la anchor pannum; water-um minerals-um absorb panna help pannum.
teaching_sequence.checkpoint: Taproot-um fibrous root-um eppadi different? Root-oda rendu functions sollunga.

teaching_sequence.title: Leaves matrum venation
teaching_sequence.caption: Leaf-la veins arrange aagura pattern venation. Hibiscus madhiri leaves-la network pola veins irukkum; adhu reticulate venation. Grass, banana madhiri leaves-la parallel lines pola veins irukkum; adhu parallel venation.
teaching_sequence.teacher_says: Oru leaf-ai light-kku opposite-aa pidichu veins-ai paarunga. Veins network-aa irukka, parallel-aa irukka-nu identify pannunga.
teaching_sequence.checkpoint: Reticulate venation-ukku oru example, parallel venation-ukku oru example sollunga.

teaching_sequence.title: Seeds, roots, leaves connect pannuvom
teaching_sequence.caption: Seed-ai soak panni split pannumbodhu seed structure-ai observe pannalaam. Monocot plants-la usually fibrous roots, parallel venation; dicot plants-la usually taproot, reticulate venation. Idhu common pattern; ella plant-aiyum observe panni verify pannunga.
teaching_sequence.teacher_says: Maize seed-um chickpea seed-um compare pannunga. Seed type, root pattern, leaf veins idaiyila irukkura relationship-ai textbook activity moolama kandupidippom.
teaching_sequence.checkpoint: Maize-um chickpea-um root matrum leaf venation-la enna difference kaattum?

teaching_sequence.title: Animals-oda diversity
teaching_sequence.caption: Animals-oda size, body covering, movement, food, living place ellam different. Fish water-la vaazhum; birds fly panna wings use pannum; frogs water-layum land-layum irukkum. Habitat animal-oda needs-ai support pannum.
teaching_sequence.teacher_says: Oru fish-ai goat-oda compare pannunga. Rendu animals-um living things; aana body parts-um habitat-um different. Indha differences avanga vaazhum idathukku suit aagum.
teaching_sequence.checkpoint: Fish-um frog-um habitat eppadi different? Animal body feature-oda habitat-ku enna connection?

teaching_sequence.title: Adaptations matrum habitats
teaching_sequence.caption: Oru habitat-la survive panna living thing-ku help pannura body features alladhu behaviours adaptations. Mountain plants, desert plants, aquatic animals ellam avanga surroundings-kku suit aana features kondirukkum.
teaching_sequence.teacher_says: Camel desert-la water loss-ai reduce panna help pannura features kondadhu. Mountain trees wind-ai face panna different shape irukkalaam. Adaptation-na environment-kku useful feature.
teaching_sequence.checkpoint: Adaptation-na enna? Oru habitat-um adhukku suit aana adaptation-um example sollunga.

teaching_sequence.title: Biodiversity-ai paadhukaappom
teaching_sequence.caption: Plants, animals, soil, water, climate ellam ecosystem-la connect aagirukkum. Habitat destroy aana living things affect aagum. Local plants-ai protect pannudhal, litter avoid pannudhal, water bodies clean-aa vechikkudhal biodiversity-ai support pannum.
teaching_sequence.teacher_says: Nature-la oru species mattum thaniya vaazhaadhu; pala living things onna depend pannum. Namma surroundings-ai care pannina biodiversity protect aagum.
teaching_sequence.checkpoint: Biodiversity yen mukkiyam? Ungal school alladhu veettil biodiversity protect panna oru action sollunga.
